headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 3 studies yielded an effect size of 1.25 (95% CI: 1.0–1.56), indicating no statistically significant association between yogurt and prostate cancer\aggressive. These findings were accompanied by substantial heterogeneity (I² = 50.31%), reflecting considerable variability across studies.
